title_khamyang: Lik4 Bhaa1 Saa1 Tai1 Nai1 Mung1 As1 Sam1
title_english: The Tai Languages of Assam: A Grammar and Texts (Complete Monograph)
informant: Dr. Stephen Morey, Chaw Sa Myat Chowlik, Deben Chowlik & Assam Tai Elders
description: Complete cover-to-cover digital structured edition of the landmark 438-page linguistic monograph 'The Tai Languages of Assam – A Grammar and Texts' (Pacific Linguistics 565, ANU Canberra, 2005) by Dr. Stephen Morey, covering all 11 chapters from phonology, tone matrices, and Lik Tai orthography to 164 pages of syntax, literature catalogs, and archiving.

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 1: Introduction to the Tai of Assam
chapters_summary.summary: Introduction to the Southwestern Tai ethnolinguistic communities in Upper Assam and Northeast India (Khamyang, Phake, Aiton, Khamti, and Ahom), their sociolinguistic environment, village field conditions, and the methodology of recording elders.

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 2: The Tais of Assam & Their Languages
chapters_summary.summary: Detailed ethnographic history of the Tai Khamyang (Nora) village of Powaimukh near Margherita, the Ahom historical accounts, the Aiton villages of the Dhansiri valley, the Phake villages of Dibrugarh and Tinsukia, and the 2002 Khamyang language revitalization movement initiated by village elders.

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 3: Previous Studies of the Tai Languages
chapters_summary.summary: Historiographical review of linguistic research on Assam Tai varieties, from Grierson's 1904 Linguistic Survey of India (Vol. II), Needham's 1894 Khamti Grammar, Banchob Bandhumedha's 1987 dictionary, to Anthony Diller's comparative Tai studies.

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 4: Phonetics and Phonology of the Tai Languages
chapters_summary.summary: Comprehensive instrumental acoustic analysis of the consonant and vowel systems across Khamyang, Phake, and Aiton. Formant analysis of vowels, voice onset time (VOT) for stops, and the unique Khamyang lateral /l/ reflex for Proto-Tai *?d.

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 5: Consonants & Proto-Tai Tonal Splits
chapters_summary.summary: Detailed historical phonology mapping Tai Khamyang tones to William J. Gedney's 20-box tone matrix (Proto-Tai tones *A, *B, *C, *D split by initial consonant voicing and glottalization into Series 1 and Series 2).

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 6: The Vowels of Southwestern Tai
chapters_summary.summary: Analysis of the nine-vowel system (/i, e, ɛ, ɯ, ə, a, u, o, ɔ/), length contrasts (a vs aa), diphthongs (/ia, ɯa, ua/), and the phonetic realizations in closed syllables with velar and glottal codas.

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 7: Orthography & The Tai Writing Systems
chapters_summary.summary: Description of the Lik Tai script used by Khamyang, Phake, and Aiton. Examination of consonant letters (to-lik), dependent vowel signs, subscript consonants (pha-tɯk), ligatures, punctuation marks, and computer font development.

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 8: Syntax of the Tai Languages of Assam
chapters_summary.summary: Massive 164-page chapter covering syntax: word classes, noun phrase structure (Noun + Adjective + Numeral + Classifier + Demonstrative), prepositional phrases, constituent order (SVO with pragmatically conditioned OSV/SOV), tense-aspect-modality (TAM) particles, multi-verb serial constructions, negation with 'am1', polar and content questions, and relative clauses.

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 9: The Literature of the Tai
chapters_summary.summary: Catalogue and literary analysis of traditional written and oral literature: Buddhist canonical Jatakas, historical Buranjis, moral advice texts (Kham Son), animal fables (Pung), liturgical chants, wedding songs, and traditional poetic meters (Khe Khyang).

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 10: Lexicography and Computer Databases
chapters_summary.summary: Documenting the creation of digital lexical databases, comparative wordlists, font encodings, and the systematic preservation of endangered vocabularies for Aiton, Phake, and Khamyang.

chapters_summary.title: Chapter 11: Electronic Formatting & Archiving
chapters_summary.summary: Technical postscript detailing digital recording of elderly native speakers, audio digitization standards (WAV/MP3), interlinear alignment in Shoebox/Toolbox, and permanent archiving in PARADISEC and ELAR.
